scope: Automatic catalog-track playback may try the existing strict-identity Audius resolver after a typed YouTube network/timeout failure. No text-substitution expansion or new provider, media, recipe or deployment.
behavior: Typed YouTube network/timeout failures in search, stream and cached automatic-source phases can try catalog once per existing operation.
Only the existing resolver that validates ISRC/title/artist/version/duration may return an alternate source.
Provider absence or error does not replace the original YouTube transport error or write a YouTube association.
Cancellation and the original45000ms operation deadline reject late recovery and prevent writes/fallback UI.
Manual choices, directly added YouTube videos, podcasts and downloads never gain this transient catalog-rescue policy.
Restricted, malformed or untyped errors do not authorize this new route.
priorPolicyTestUpdated: Restrictions/response exclusions now count actual catalog calls; typed-network recovery has explicit positive and negative tests.
limitations: Synthetic module-level transport/storage fixtures only; not a new live-provider coverage claim.
Existing mixed definitive/transport failure policy and existing definitive-error download rescue remain unchanged.
No build, publication, recipe refresh or commit by this agent.
